title: Credible Source — Five Tips to Determine If Your Source Is Credible
skills: identify common indicators of source credibility
evaluate authorship, evidence, publication quality, and relevance
distinguish trustworthy sources from weak or questionable sources
apply credibility checks when selecting evidence for research
alignment_note: Presents five practical criteria students can use to determine whether a source is credible. Supports information literacy, source evaluation, research planning, evidence selection, and responsible academic writing across high school English courses.
